qualification_requirements.attestation_key_requirement: The externally installed runtime names an environment variable holding its raw base64 Ed25519 private key. Catalogs pin only the matching public key and key identifier; no credential, endpoint, repository, or key is present here.
qualification_requirements.policy_requirement: Runtime configuration maps each credential to one client_id and exact profile grants, pins one external Plan commit, an explicit bounded active-request capacity, runtime interpreter/dependency/environment digests, and exact allowlisted test command/runner, migration runner, or review runner profiles. The service itself resolves the candidate/base trees and performs execution.
qualification_requirements.retention_requirement: A PASS proof requires the complete retained transcript. Candidate admission S must retain one signed test/migration proof pair for every receipt; independent-review X retains a separate review proof pair whose signed input hashes equal the exact review packet and result bytes.
qualification_requirements.launch_rule: This template is not a service configuration and must not be passed to a launcher, card, or admission gate. Deployment must provision the isolated repository checkout, policy configuration, client credentials, signing key, and immutable catalog separately.
